Metadata.description: The UNICEF club of School No. 130 in Ulaanbaatar: students helping children inside and outside school, promoting children's rights and organising volunteer activities.

Footer.about: A UNICEF-inspired student club helping children inside and outside our school. Founded in 2025.

About.title: A club of students who want to help children
About.intro: The 130 UNICEF club was founded in 2025 on the initiative of active students of School No. 130. It is a volunteer club that follows UNICEF's values.
About.story1: A few friends started with a simple question: "How can we help children?" In 2025, with the support of our teachers, we officially founded the club.
About.story2: Today we do many things together — from reading to younger pupils to visiting care centres and organising donation drives.
About.mission: To help children inside and outside our school, promote children's rights and build a caring community through volunteering.
